article: 4, 5, 6 and the article on the limitation of the civil action (law 25-14)
why: A tort claim for an act that is also an offence: the stay of the civil case, the choice between the civil and the criminal route, and the limitation of the civil action. Not in the store; open point o1.
A boundary of this claim: road traffic accidents compensated under the compulsory motor-insurance regime rather than personal fault. Not in the store; open point o2.

article: whole law (compensation of work accidents and occupational illnesses)
why: A boundary of this claim: harm from a work accident or occupational illness under the social-security regime. Not in the store; open point o3.

article: provisions on press offences and their limitation
why: Defamation through the media may carry special periods. Not in the store; open point o5.
The store's note on 124 says the 2005 wording has no national commencement date; the earlier wording is needed for harmful acts before it took effect. Open point o6.
